name: aenean-swelling-gusts-deals-damage-equal-to-wind-objects-you-control
notes: Aenean Swelling Gusts: X = wind element objects you control (2). Pre-fix 0 damage ($windCount undefined).

rulesClauses: Deal X damage to target unit, where X is the amount of wind element objects you control.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Aenean Swelling Gusts: the generated handler ($windCount) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
